props.description: Split-screen comparison: left panel shows a matplotlib bar chart enclosed in all four border spines against a gray background, labeled 'Before'. Right panel shows the identical chart with only bottom and left spines, white grid, labeled 'After'. The top and right borders on the left panel pulse red, then a line draws across to the right panel's clean version. A Tufte quote fades in: 'The borders add no information.' The animation makes the visual improvement feel like a genuine before/after discovery.
